body:
Only `replace_unchecked` doesn't handle it I think: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/43d99bb583866c1adb4aa88f19b88637df0a7f33/crates/bevy_ecs/src/storage/blob_vec.rs#L101-L106

`swap_remove_and_drop_unchecked` calls `self.drop` as last action before returning: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/43d99bb583866c1adb4aa88f19b88637df0a7f33/crates/bevy_ecs/src/storage/blob_vec.rs#L160-L164

`clear` sets `self.len = 0` first before dropping anything, ensuring a leak in case of a panicking drop: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/43d99bb583866c1adb4aa88f19b88637df0a7f33/crates/bevy_ecs/src/storage/blob_vec.rs#L183-L196

> `swap_remove_and_drop_unchecked` calls `self.drop` as last action before returning:

It depends on what the callers do. In the code path I've looked at, the entity is [removed](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/43d99bb583866c1adb4aa88f19b88637df0a7f33/crates/bevy_ecs/src/world/entity_ref.rs#L489-L492) from the world before [drop](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/43d99bb583866c1adb4aa88f19b88637df0a7f33/crates/bevy_ecs/src/world/entity_ref.rs#L514-L516) is called. So there is no problem.

Without the additional knowledge that `swap_remove_unchecked` can panic and leave memory in a half-dropped state, it might also seem valid to swap the relative positions of the linked lines.
`swap_remove_and_drop_unchecked` and `clear` should be fine. Only `replace_unchecked` has a bug.
That did be a bug in `World`, not `BlobVec` I think.
